key_insight: Integral constraints can improve PINN accuracy by restoring uniform control over error components that the standard loss controls only weakly in certain PDE parameter regimes.
engineering_relevance: For PDE simulation, integral constraints offer a targeted way to improve PINN accuracy when stability analysis identifies weakly controlled errors.
method: Derive stability estimates for several PDEs with standard and integral-constraint losses.
Compare error control across parameter regimes.
Test predicted accuracy differences in numerical experiments.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments show clear accuracy differences where standard-loss control is predicted to be weak, but similar accuracy where it remains sufficient.
watch_item: Benefits depend on the PDE and parameter regime; integral constraints are not a universal accuracy improvement.
paper_title: When and why can integral constraints improve the accuracy of physics-informed neural networks?
